name: AesculaTech
long_description:
AesculaTech believes in building better lives through smart chemistry. We design custom smart materials for a range of biomedical, commercial, and industrial applications. Our platform technology, AesculaGel offers adaptive response to a wide range of stimuli and can be tailor-made for biocompatibility, material strength, and a range of other attributes. 

Founded by one of MIT's 35 under 35 Innovators, AesculaTech is the shared vision of scientists, engineers, and medical experts. Our cornerstone product, Humidifeye, is an ophthalmic platform to treat dry eye disease. Dry eye affects more than 25 million Americans and the global treatment market is projected higher than $6 Billion within the next decade. Our thermally responsive, form-fitting materials are suitable for sustained yet reversible occlusion across a range of treatment times. In contrast to existing technologies, our product will not extrude, or cause discomfort as it adapts to patients. Though Humidifeye is not yet FDA approved, expect to hear about it soon!

In coordination with partners across several sectors, we have a variety of groundbreaking technologies in the works that live up to our vision. This work has already been recognized. AesculaTech was named a Rosenman Innovator, received a National Science Foundation I-Corps grant, was a finalist in the 2019 Octane High Tech Awards, and is a graduate of both the Y Combinator and TMCx accelerator programs. In short, Y-Combinator was only the beginning.

I was included in MIT's 2018 35 Innovators Under 35. My company participated in YCombinator 2018.

launches.title: Pippa: a Pelvic Floor Fitness Booster for Women
launches.body:
# **Meet Pippa**

# The world's first workout product designed to boost pelvic floor fitness—just by wearing it while you move.

[https://youtu.be/OP0vhTb6n8U?si=ZOPh69qU3PaznicV](https://youtu.be/OP0vhTb6n8U?si=ZOPh69qU3PaznicV%5C)

Pippa is worn internally (like a tampon). The soft silicone spring gently conforms to the body, activating pelvic floor muscles with each step, stretch, or squat. No batteries, no routines—just natural, effortless, on-the-go exercise.

**✅**  Significantly increases neuromuscular activation\
✅  Fits seamlessly into a daily workout or walk\
✅  Two models for a comfy, personalized fit

**The Problem**

78M American women worry about pelvic floor weakness, including college and pro athletes, new moms, and older women. Pelvic floor weakness can lead to a range of problems, including urinary and fecal incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, and more, significantly impacting quality of life. Most solutions are high-effort, expensive, inconvenient — or all of the above.

# **The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/4f74514a-9282-4194-b496-f5a8f8bb9a9e)

Pippa is the world’s first _conforming resistance spring._ It comes in two sizes and levels of resistance: light (42mm) and medium (50mm).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/b5b7eaf1-5356-4c53-a2f9-deb7d4cb441e)

It works like a resistance band, but for hard-to-reach inner core.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/0d8c4d39-8f5e-41f3-ad68-1bd2736df857)

Pippa passively responds to core muscle movement by expanding and compressing, thereby activating the muscles and increasing effective function by up to 35%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/483ecf52-ea8b-4f74-9b7f-11f453d8460e)

The reusable applicator makes it easy to put Pippa into place. The large finger loop makes anytime removal a breeze.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/c47281f3-861d-4a89-baef-c1226c1e9092)

# **The Founders**

Product inventor, [Carly Price](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pricecarly/) (L), has designed many award-winning and commercially successful consumer products. She conceived Pippa after trying different solutions for kegel exercise and bladder support, none of which met her comfort and convenience expectations. \
\
Cofounder and CEO, [Melody Roberts](https://www.linkedin.com/in/melodyannroberts/) (R), incubated service models and self-ordering solutions for McDonald’s and Panera. \
\
We worked with a wide range of experts–including urogynecologists, physiotherapists, and other health professionals–to ensure Pippa would be comfortable and fully safe.

# **Our Asks**

* **Get the full story** at [**Kickstarter**](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/liv-labs/get-fit-inside-and-out-with-pippa)
* **Share this post** **with friends and family** of any age
* **Suggest potential retailers** to [**melody@livlabsfitness.com**](mailto:melody@liv-labs.com)

name: Scout
long_description:
Digital health holds a lot of potential but is ignoring a growing problem: diagnostic testing. Without this data, providers and organizations will be limited in the services they can provide patients at home.

Scout has developed a platform - Hub, test kits, and app - that delivers health testing at home with 10x lower development cost and 3x lower per-test price. Our patented tech also meets performance requirements for medical diagnoses and integrates with the current healthcare tech stack. Scout’s technology is poised to disrupt the outdated $33Bn diagnostic market by democratizing testing while dramatically improving the patient experience.

Scout has received $16M in non-dilutive funding from the NIH and other organizations to fully de-risk our platform, and our pipeline includes a diverse test menu for primary care (e.g. respiratory and sexual health), wellness (e.g. gut health), and chronic conditions (e.g. certain cancers). We have already received FDA authorization for our platform in clinical settings and are planning to launch our flagship Scout Hub in 2024.
one_liner: The smart testing platform that unlocks digital health at home.

launches.tagline: Adding meat back into plant-based meat to make protein meat eaters want.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

_At_ [_Momentum Foods_](https://www.linkedin.com/company/momentumfoods/)_, we’re adding meat back into plant-based meat to make it more affordable, healthy, and delicious._ 

### **Overview**

After five years developing and scaling textured protein (the base of every product) at Beyond Meat, I realized two things:

1. Plant-based meat companies don’t have a clear path to improving product quality _and_ decreasing cost.
2. The 96% of the population that regularly eats meat cares more about cost, health, and flavor than whether their food is vegan.

By combining plant protein with the best parts of meat, we can finally make a product that’s less expensive than the real thing, but nearly indistinguishable from it — all while being better for the planet.

### **Our Retail Brand, Paul’s Table:**

[Paul’s Table](https://www.paulstable.com/) delivers our vision of competitive price, flavor, and health. Everyday products for everyday people. Coming to stores in Summer 2023.

launches.title: Dex – Your AI Coworker for the Browser
launches.tagline: Turn your browser into a smart interface that works alongside you.
launches.body:
Hey! We’re Kevin and Regina from [Dexterity](https://getdexterity.com/). Today, we’re launching Dex—the fastest interface for co-working with AI, right inside your browser.

**TLDR:** **AI that works _with you,_ not just for you**. 10x your workflows without breaking your flow. Try [**Dex**](https://youtu.be/H6hMAVkGp8M) (Beta) → [**getdexterity.com**](http://getdexterity.com)

### **Why We’re Building This**

**Four weeks before Demo Day, we pivoted to build for ourselves.**

Most AI web agents today are “set-and-forget” chats—you hand them off and check back later. But what about workflows you actually _want_ to drive? Navigating platforms, moving data, making quick decisions—these moments demand instant, context-aware models that work with you, not just for you.

Imagine using Operator to order DoorDash—a frustratingly back-and-forth relay with no real-time visibility. That same friction exists for work tools like Jira, GSuite, and GitHub, where users need instant feedback and responsive action, not slow AI handoffs.

**That’s why we’re taking a Cursor (vs. Devin) approach—for the browser.**

### **The Problem**

Modern work is a juggling act of 15+ tabs, software bloat, and constant UI friction, just to complete a single task.

The real bottleneck isn’t just automation—it’s context switching. Traditional solutions force users to memorize shortcuts (appeals to devs, but leaves everyone else behind), while AI tools make you adapt to them instead of living right where you work.

**Why not turn your browser itself into an intelligent personal workspace?**

### **How It Works**

With simple voice and text, Dex enhances familiar interfaces, automates mundane actions, and understands your intent.

* **Smart Navigation**🔸Find, execute, and move between apps.
* **Suggest Context**🔸Cut down tab-switching and manual searching.
* **Cross-App Automation**🔸Shortcut multi-step workflows, zero setup.
* **Adaptive UI/UX**🔸Reshape, replicate, and browse by your rules.

Think of it like Spotlight Search meets AI automation + personal expert for everyday apps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87902&key=user_uploads/1003357/5841f4c8-281d-4bdd-a4b0-053d44c7b41d)

### **Use Cases**

* **GSuite** – Write emails, find docs, and move data anywhere.
* **GitHub** – Search repos, manage issues, and navigate faster.
* **Omni AI** – Talk to and reference live tabs or integrated apps.

### **Coming Soon…**

* **Meetings** 📅 → Create and join calendar and Zoom events instantly
* **Sales** 💼 → Automate clicks across LinkedIn, Sheets, and Apollo.io
* **Snippets** ✂️ → Dex captures notes, links, and frequent snippets
* **Food** 🍔 → Speak to browse options and order DoorDash

### **Our Ask**

We’re building Dex for power users, founders, students, and curious explorers—because that’s who we are.

[**Join our waitlist**](https://getdexterity.com/) → **Get notified when Dex goes live on the Chrome store**.\
[**Follow us on Twitter**](https://x.com/dexterity_ai) → Stay updated on latest features.\
[**Discord**](https://x.com/dexterity_ai) → Get to know us more personally + brainstorm cool ideas.

Drop dream features to [regina@getdexterity.com](mailto:regina@getdexterity.com) and let us know what you think!

launches.title: MarkIt: Silver Bullet for Trade Compliance
launches.body:
Hey Everyone!

Excited to share our story and what we’ve been working on.

https://youtu.be/kdNXKa-zfcg

When Chan worked on Tesla’s Global Trade team, every car part—bolts, batteries, doors, etc—came from a different country. Each time tariffs shifted (pretty frequently), he and his team had to manually check thousands of parts across hundreds of pages of trade rules. Pair that with meetings with consultants, brokers, & suppliers to get potentially the worst workflow of 2025. All happening within Outlook & Excel 2019.\
They tried software, consultants, startups — every one of them got shot down due to reasons like product quality & data security, but mainly that it doesn’t bring enough value.

That’s why we built **MarkIt** — AI agents that actually _do the work_ for Suppliers, Brokers, and OEMs.

# **Introducing MarkIt - The Silver Bullet for Trade Compliance**

With agents that live where trade professionals already work — **Excel, broker portals, and browser** — MarkIt helps teams classify products, manage tariffs, and resolve customs issues in seconds, not hours.

# **MarkIt’s Value: Product & Logic Application**

MarkIt is intentionally lightweight, and customizable. Previously, without AI, software in this industry was clunky & typically automating a set workflow. Now, MarkIt services all of your workflow needs in a single

* **Classification**: MarkIt can enhance your workflows at scale. Entries are

  **defensible** with thorough **reasoning** and **supporting documents**.
* **OCR**: Upload your Bill of Ladings, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, and other documents to create your import filings and reports.
* **Customization**: Users can choose to **use their own logic**, where MarkIt’s platform would simply handle applying it at volume. No more worrying about reasonable care, if you don’t trust AI research.
* **Build Your Own:** MarkIt’s agents can work in files & desktop, applying trade logic in your own customizable way.
* **Integration:** Plug directly into ABIs and ERPs **only if you want.**

MarkIt is like a coworker specialized in customs & the trade process. Who’s willing to do all of your mindless “dishwashing” work.

# **Our Ask:**

We’re looking to connect with anyone who works in Global Trade. Suppliers, customs brokers, manufacturers, e-commerce operators, etc.

MarkIt: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/markittrade/)

Chan: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chanhkim/)

Roland: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rsaav/)

name: Light Anchor

Consumer brands have always grown at the speed of the people running them. Every new product, market, or channel meant more hires.

AI agents can now handle marketing, operations, product development, and manufacturing from start to finish. That makes a new kind of business possible: one limited by compute, not headcount.

Today, Light Anchor operates 10 brands, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. Our goal is to run thousands of consumer brands, operating with little to no human intervention.

launches.title: Light Anchor: the AI-native P&G
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋! We're [Chase](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chasingjohnn/) and [Sangha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanghaha/), co-founders of Light Anchor.

### TL;DR: Light Anchor is building the AI-native P&G: consumer brands run end-to-end by AI agents.

We've reached $10M in annualized product revenue within 3 months of launch, with 20,000+ customers across the US.

The factory unlocked mass production. The internet unlocked mass distribution. AI unlocks mass creation, and brands are next.

Consumer brands hire teams and agencies to scale. We believe this work can now be run fully autonomously by agents. Today Light Anchor runs 10 brands using agents across marketing, operations, logistics, and inventory management, and is growing 70% week-over-week on average.

<https://youtu.be/xNaJ5rG2Q78>

### Why consumer brands?

Building a brand today is hard and expensive, so most brands build for the millions. 

Brands have always been bottlenecked by how fast humans (or agencies) can run them. With agents that operate end-to-end, the cost of building a brand approaches zero and is capped by compute, not headcount. That makes it possible for every small need to have its own brand: better products, lower prices, and thousands of new brands for everyone.

We partnered with 10 Korean beauty & wellness brands as an AI-native services agency to test whether agents could do the HARD things: marketing, logistics, inventory management, and back-office operations. Turns out they can! (for the most of it)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=130726&key=user_uploads/3198656/a8fbd851-468b-44de-b9e4-914aab510954)

(daily sales growth per brand)

### How it works: the "Company World Model"

Every brand we run produces a stream of operating decisions: creatives tested, ad dollars spent, inventory planned, suppliers negotiated, tickets closed. Everything else is built on that record:

* **Agent harness**: Our tools, procedures, memory, and guardrails turn any frontier model into an operator for our brands. The agents learn from every decision and result.
* **Creative engine**: Agents turn winning references into live, brand-accurate ads across video, image, voice, and text, with AI judges checking every frame.
* **Computer use agents**: Agents work directly in business software (e.g. Amazon Seller Central) where there's no API, and check every change live.
* **Data flywheel**: What one brand learns, every brand uses. More data means better predictions, better products, and more sales.

Every investment we make in the platform compounds across every brand we run, and every brand we'll ever run. Our bet isn't just that we can operate more brands. It's that this learning compounds, and we can build stronger brands than any existing ones (P&G here we come!).

### Asks

We are hiring! If you're any of the following, or know someone who is, we'd love an intro from:

* Consumer brands (marketing, product development, manufacturing, operations).
* Meta ad experts
* AI UGC experts

Reach us at [founders@lightanchor.ai](mailto:founders@lightanchor.ai).

### Team

We met at Sendbird (YC W16), where we led the AI agent product and forward deployment teams during its 2024 pivot into AI agents for customer experience. Sendbird built the messaging APIs behind DoorDash, Reddit, and Hinge.

Some pics for smiles/giggles: 1) our first picture as co-founders, 2) our first packing, and 3) our first shipment!!

launches.title: Rhem Labs: Health assistant robots for your parents
launches.tagline: Rhem handles everything that doesn’t need a pair of hands, while keeping you in the loop.
launches.body:
## TLDR:

**Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed with older adults in mind, but it’s for anyone who wants help getting things done and staying on top of their health.**

Preorders are open now at <https://rhem.ai>

<https://youtu.be/LnNPjpNq_uE>

## 

## The Problem

**At some point, you start paying attention to your parents differently.**

Maybe there was a scare. Maybe Mom missed an appointment. Maybe Dad sounds more tired. Or maybe nothing happened at all. You just start wondering whether everything is as fine as they say.

If you don’t live with them, you mostly get snapshots: a call, a text, a FaceTime.

**You don’t see the full day.**

You don’t know if routines are slipping, something is getting harder, or a small change is becoming a pattern.

**We learned this the hard way with my grandmother.**

Before her stroke, she was sleeping badly, talking less, and seemed unlike herself.

The signs were there. But my dad had a newborn and a full-time job. My grandfather was working too. Everyone cared, but no one saw the whole picture.

**We each saw pieces. No one put them together until something much bigger happened.**

## **How it works for your parents**

Rhem lives in the home and becomes the easiest way for your parent to get things done and keep track of their health.

They just need to say:

“Remind me after dinner.”

“When is my appointment?”

“Order our usual groceries.”

“Tell Jacob I need a ride tomorrow.”

Rhem can browse websites, make calls, manage reminders, answer questions, place supported orders, and follow up.

**If it doesn’t require a pair of hands, Rhem can probably handle it.**

They can also take supported wellness readings on Rhem, keep track of routines, and see how things change over time.

When something needs you, **Rhem brings you into the loop through the rhem connect app.** You can answer a question, add context, or help finish the task. **Help Rhem once, and it remembers how to do it next time.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117929&key=user_uploads/1690205/9adf4655-4900-4fe0-bdec-29e333c8a3dd)

## **How it works for families**

Your parent gets an assistant. **You get a clearer picture of how they’re doing.**

The Rhem app brings together health readings, routines, requests, completed tasks, and alerts. You can see what changed, what Rhem handled, and when you’re needed.

From anywhere, you can send reminders, leave voice messages, ask Rhem to check in, talk to your parent, or ask about information they’ve shared.

Over time, Rhem helps you spot patterns. **One bad night may mean nothing. A month of worse sleep, missed appointments, and changes in routine is something you want to know about.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117929&key=user_uploads/1690205/c7652236-3ca9-40a0-9ea8-d1e2160852fc)

## **Why we built Rhem**

**We’re a father-and-son team, and our family spent nearly two decades caring for loved ones at home.**

Before my grandmother had a stroke, there were signs that something was changing. She was sleeping badly, talking less, and seemed unlike herself. We all noticed pieces of it, but nobody had the full picture until much later.

My aunt had a different problem. A brain tumor left her with limited mobility, so a lot of everyday things depended on someone else being available. Making a call. Looking something up. Ordering something. Figuring out what needed to happen next.

A lot of the time, she didn’t need someone physically next to her. She needed someone who could help her get things done.

That’s where Rhem came from.

**We wanted something that could notice when things were changing, help with the everyday stuff, and bring family in when they were actually needed.**

The goal is simple: give our parents more independence, while letting us spend more time being their family instead of managing everything around them.

## **Team**

Jacob: Berkeley CS & DS, researcher at Berkeley AI Robotics Lab with a focus on full stack autonomous driving and edge computing, founding engineer at Mattoboard.

Huey: Executive leader with 30+ years of experience building smart hardware with embedded software at scale and leading global operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117929&key=user_uploads/1690205/2ae2c872-97c6-4ff3-9c05-dde53439c9b4)

## Why order now

If you’re ordering a Founding Edition, thank you.

We know we’re asking you to trust a new company and buy something for someone you care deeply about. We don’t take that lightly.

**Every Founding Edition includes:**

* **Founding Price of $1099 before our price increase to $1499 on Jan 20th**
* **1 x Halo Non-wearable Fall Detector ($80 Value)**
* **2 years of Rhem Plus included ($480 Value)**
* **2 x Merch Pack & Goodies**
* **Direct access to our team** for setup, questions, and feedback

**Thank you for being here at the beginning. We can’t wait for Rhem to start making your parents’ lives a little easier.**

Preorder now at: <https://rhem.ai>

**_Here's to more good years with the people who raised us. 💙_**

**— Jacob & Huey**
